reviewer.independence: The reviewer did not author or generate the replacement assets, did not treat canonical pending states or prior package ratings as approval, and made no canonical package or approval changes.

method.originalFileTreatment: The two replacement Mexican Tinwork files were opened and inspected directly at their full 800x1000 resolution. SHA-256 reconciliation proved that the other 148 current ledger assets are byte-identical to the files the same reviewer previously opened and judged at original resolution.
method.fullSizeTreatment: The refreshed Mexican Tinwork style sheet was directly inspected in its 500x625 full-view panels. The other 148 assets retain the reviewer's prior full-view judgments because their current image bytes are identical and the current contact-sheet manifest maps the same paths into the rebuilt sheets.
method.cardScaleTreatment: The refreshed Mexican Tinwork style sheet was directly inspected in its 200x250 card-scale panels. The other 148 assets retain the reviewer's prior card-scale judgments through the same byte-level and manifest reconciliation.
method.setTreatment: The refreshed Mexican Tinwork style sheet and folk-vernacular family sheet were directly inspected for accuracy, teaching role, legibility, composition, integrity, differentiation, and family separation. The other 119 style-set and 11 family-set judgments were reconciled to the unchanged 148 source bytes and exact current 150-asset manifest.
method.acceptanceBar: 150/150 approved strong non-misleading assets, 120/120 strong style sets, 120 excellent leads, and zero failures.
